drafts/demo-video-script.md.prompt: Write a 2 to 3 minute demo video script for Proof of Breath. Beats: a headline about an AI agent deleting a production database; Claude Code tries terraform destroy and is blocked and a gate window opens; consent screen, camera-on indicator, random pattern, target and measured curves converging, live pulse indicator, pass and the command proceeds; attack montage of a photo, a replayed video and ignoring the pacer, all rejected; the typed fallback for accessibility; the receipts page with the chain verified and an evaluation chart. Close with: Proves a live, attentive human. Never stores video. Do not invent numbers: write [RESULTS PENDING] where numbers belong. Describe it only as checking presence and attention.

drafts/dev-post-draft.md.prompt: Draft a DEV.to post for a project called Proof of Breath, for the Presage SmartSpectra SDK Challenge. It holds destructive commands from AI coding agents until a live person follows a random breathing pattern measured by a webcam using the SDK. Use these exact sections: What I Built, Demo, Code, How It Responds to Human Signals, Prize Categories, Consent and Data Handling, Agent Session. Rules: describe it only as checking presence and attention, and say plainly it is not identity authentication. Make no statements about wellbeing or the body beyond 'a live pulse signal is present'. Do not invent any results or numbers: write [RESULTS PENDING] wherever evaluation numbers belong. Write in plain, direct English.
